items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Braud Hat Brow; the mention is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Well, I always forget about the Milton
No, that's okay. I just wanted it on the record, so they knew who that was.

Panama, you talked about drumming and when you started drumming -- were there any drummers that you heard that inspired you to want to be a drummer? I know in my case, I used to hear Duke's band come through and admired Braud Hat Brow and I thought he was a marvelous base player and I wanted to be like him. But was there anybody, any drummers that you looked up to?
